item.description:
江卓尔_莱比特矿池
注意这种技术分析，
提供的是 “更可能会怎么走”，
而不是 “板上钉钉会这么走”。

任何事物都是在不断发展的，
比如明天美股开盘，
ETF如果有增量资金，
就可能把反弹进一步往上推。

所以千万不要据此就觉得 “肯定要跌了”
“立马开个高倍杠杆空进去”

技术分析只是把裸赌的五成胜率，
提高到六七成，
而不是九十成，
切记！

刚才说 “目前的反弹到66k（最多到67.5k）就是最高”，
有人问为什么。

因为这一轮反弹，
是空头拥挤、回补导致的反弹，
不是多头买入导致的反弹。

出现了以下特征：
1、最低点出现了资金费率负数，
此处做空的人拥挤，
导致了V型反转。

2、持仓量下降，
空头主动回补平仓。

3、现货CVD基本横着，
说明即使跌成这个样子，
也没人买现货，
大家都预期还没到底。

空头回补导致的反弹，
是一次性的弱势反弹，
空头回补的燃料耗尽，
就涨不上去了，
也就是现在的情况。

不像多头买入导致的反弹，
有可能一直持续下去，
甚至走成反转 ： ） - 江卓尔_莱比特矿池
tweet

不像多头买入导致的反弹，
有可能一直持续下去，
甚至走成反转 ： ）

为什么我早上不仅开了对冲空单，
还把之前抄底的小币种都割了？
https://t.co/ApjMo2tSyy

因为有个很不利的因素，
最近一年每一轮30%的下跌，
都对应着日线级别的底部放量，
（一根或多根日线）

但本轮已经跌了29.1%，
跌得中间一路平推没有反弹，
跌出了312的气势，
但日线居然还没有放量，
这说明恐慌盘还没有出来，
还有最后一杀。

没有最后一杀都能破62k，
那最后恐慌出来，
破60k大概率事件，
那就已经破了我昨天文章说的，
牛初的证伪条件：
VAL（30%成交量）的61576。

当然我并不是说肯定会破57.8k的前低，
但这轮下跌还没有结束是大概率事件，
目前的反弹到66k（最多到67.5k）就是最高，
然后会开启新一轮的下跌，
目标直指破60k。

要把最后的恐慌盘打出来，
这轮下跌才能结束，
然后继续走横盘震荡。 - 江卓尔_莱比特矿池

item.title: DeleteMe Can you spot a scam? International Fraud Awareness Week runs November 1
item.description:
DeleteMe
Can you spot a scam?

International Fraud Awareness Week runs November 15 to 21. Learn the red flags now, before a scammer tests you.

Watch for these signs:

- Urgency. Scammers push you to act now, before you can think.
- Secrecy. Anyone who says "don't tell your bank or family" is a threat.
- Unusual payment requests. Gift cards, crypto, and wire transfers are common scam tools.
- Unsolicited contact. Treat unexpected calls, texts, and emails with suspicion.
- Requests for codes or passwords. Real companies don't ask for them.
- Offers that seem too good to be true. They usually are.

If you get hit, report fast. Call your bank or card issuer first. Then file a report at https://t.co/i86Rw4JeK8, and at https://t.co/Llp5PlMHpL for internet-enabled crimes. Quick reporting can stop further harm and may improve the odds of recovering money.

Better still, make yourself harder to target. Scammers use personal data from data brokers to make their pitch sound real: your name, address, phone number, and relatives. Remove your info from broker sites. Tighten social media privacy settings. Share less in public.

Fewer details online means fewer chances for a scammer to trick you.

#FraudAwarenessWeek #ScamPrevention #FraudPrevention #DataPrivacy #OnlineSafety #CyberSecurity

item.title: jan/pow RT @ckba_build : Seven years ago today, CKB's mainnet went live. Ten mon
item.description:
jan/pow
RT @ckba_build: Seven years ago today, CKB's mainnet went live.

Ten months before launch, tucked away in its section on the virtual machine, the whitepaper said being crypto-agnostic "allows CKB users to keep their assets secure even in the post-quantum era."

That's because signature checks were never hardcoded into CKB's protocol. Every coin is guarded by a lock script running on CKB's RISC-V VM, so new signature schemes can be added just like any other software.

This year, the quantum threat moved up the agenda for the biggest chains. Ethereum researchers want to clear room in the next hard fork for post-quantum signatures, and Bitcoin developers are drafting a soft fork. Either way, changing the cryptography takes a fork and a ton of coordinated work.

On CKB, a post-quantum lock based on SPHINCS+ is already live on mainnet. Adding it took no fork.

In 2019, the whitepaper called it being crypto-agnostic. Today, the industry calls it crypto-agility.

Seven years and 21 million blocks in. Happy birthday, CKB.
tweet

11 月 15 日，约 6.4 万台 BTC 矿机遭遇大规模算力劫持，攻击者未经授权将矿机切换至 OCEAN 矿池，并将挖矿收益地址设置为自己控制的钱包。

此次攻击于北京时间 11 月 15 日上午 10:00 左右开始，涉及算力约 13 EH/s。OCEAN 矿池算力一度飙升至接近 50 EH/s。

矿场托管服务商 CoreX Hosting 最先发出警报。受影响运营商怀疑 Luxor 的 Commander 矿机管理软件可能是攻击入口，但目前尚未得到独立证实。

值得注意的是，攻击者最终未能成功挖出任何 BTC 区块，因此没有获得区块奖励。不过，矿工在攻击期间损失的正常挖矿收益无法追回。

目前攻击似乎已经结束，被劫持算力已从 13 EH/s 降至约 100 PH/s。

这次攻击没有偷走矿机，却直接劫持了矿工的生产力。

🚨 64,000 BITCOIN MINERS HIJACKED IN MASSIVE ATTACK

An estimated 64,000 Bitcoin miners representing 13 EH/s of hashrate were reportedly hijacked overnight, with their mining power redirected to OCEAN mining pool and payouts assigned to an attacker-controlled Bitcoin address.

The attack reportedly began around 8 PM CT on November 14.

OCEAN’s dashboard shows a sharp spike in hashrate, briefly approaching 50 EH/s before falling back toward 40 EH/s.

CoreX Hosting first raised the alarm, reporting that miners were being redirected without authorization.

One affected operator says their entire mining farm was hijacked and identified Luxor’s Commander mining management software as the source of the compromise.

Other operators reported similar unauthorized pool changes several days earlier, potentially pointing to a broader incident.

CoreX later reported that the attack appeared to be over, with the hijacked hashrate falling from 13 EH/s to approximately 100 PH/s.

The attackers reportedly failed to mine a Bitcoin block during the hijack, meaning no block rewards were collected.

However, affected miners permanently lost the opportunity to earn Bitcoin during the attack. That hashing time cannot be recovered.

The full scope of the breach and whether Luxor Commander was compromised have yet to be independently confirmed. - Bitcoin News
